name: VideoPlayer
title: VideoPlayer
summary: A 16:9 video frame: a poster with a large white play button, caption and duration chips, and while playing a bottom control bar with seek, time, captions, settings and full screen.
whenToUse: Use for ISM stories, field reports and dot.Bible app explainers on ism.bible.
Use one featured video per section, with a title and summary under it.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for audio-only Scripture; use AudioPlayer.
Do not use as a decorative background loop.

props.name: title
props.description: Video title. Rendered as the visible `.h4` under the frame and used in the play button name.

props.name: titleText
props.description: Plain-text title for the accessible name of the play button. Falls back to `title` when it is a string.

props.name: durationLabel
props.description: Spoken duration for the play button name, e.g. "4 minutes 12 seconds".

props.name: captionsChip
props.description: Poster chip next to CC, e.g. "12 languages". Omit when there are no captions.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Called when the state changes. Start loading and playing the media here: this component renders no `<video>`.

props.name: onSeek
props.description: Called when the reader seeks (click on the track, or arrow, Home and End keys).

props.name: onCaptionsChange
props.description: Called when the CC button is pressed.

props.name: caption
props.description: Caption line shown above the bar while captions are on.

props.name: onFullscreen
props.description: Called when Full screen is pressed.

props.name: formatPlayLabel
props.description: Builds the poster play button name.

props.name: hideAfter
props.description: Seconds of inactivity before the bar hides while playing.

variantNotes: Poster: `.mn-scrim` (light bottom fade), centered `.mn-playbtn` (76px white circle), chips bottom-left (captions) and bottom-right (duration).
Playing: `.mn-scrim-play` (stronger fade), `.mn-caption` above the bar, `.mn-vctrl` controls. Controls show on hover, tap or focus and hide after a few seconds of play.
Play button: default (white, black icon), hover (Horizon Blue, white icon), focus (Horizon Blue ring). `.mn-playbtn-static` is a 56px specimen for spec sheets.
Control buttons `.mn-vbtn` (44px): hover white 14% fill; captions on (`aria-pressed="true"`) shows a `--blue-on-dark` underline; focus `--blue-on-dark` outline.
Seek: track white 30%, buffered white 35%, played `--gradient-line`, 14px white knob.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: The play button is white at rest; it turns Horizon Blue only on hover. No other blue in the frame.
Show the duration chip and a captions chip on every poster; captions are on by default when available.
Played progress uses `--gradient-line`, not Horizon Blue.
All controls are 44px. Keep them in one row: play, mute, time, spacer, captions, settings, full screen.
Never autoplay with sound. Load the video only after the play press.
Always pair the player with a visible title (`.h4`) and one-line summary.

accessibility: The play button's label includes the title and duration.
The seek bar is a focusable slider with `aria-valuetext` ("1:24 of 4:12").
Captions and Mute are toggles with `aria-pressed`; swap Play/Pause labels with the icon.
Provide captions for every video, and a transcript link for longer ones.
The poster image is decorative (`alt=""`); the title names the video.
Controls stay visible while any of them has keyboard focus.
content: Title states who and what: "Reading John together, across three countries".
Summary one sentence: "Friends in Kenya, Peru and the Philippines meet on a video call to read John 3 in their own languages."
